name: Jiangsu Phoenix Publishing & Media Corporation Limited
summary: Jiangsu Phoenix Publishing & Media Corporation Limited engages in the editing, publishing, and distribution of books, newspapers, electronic publications, and audio-visual products in China. The company also engages in the publication and distribution of teaching aids; distribution of general books, textbooks, and teaching aids; sale of teaching equipment; logistics distribution; and the cultural and commercial real estate operation.
